data.summary:
**When:** [Your Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase) or [either player's Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase), as one of your **ADEPTUS ASTARTES** units is **selected to attack**.

**Target:** That **ADEPTUS ASTARTES** unit.

**Effect:** The unit's attacks get one of these, as you pick:

- **[[LETHAL HITS]](vsdata:weapon-ability/lethal-hits)**
- **[[SUSTAINED HITS 1]](vsdata:weapon-ability/sustained-hits)**
- if the unit is **entrenched**, both **[[LETHAL HITS]](vsdata:weapon-ability/lethal-hits)** and **[[SUSTAINED HITS 1]](vsdata:weapon-ability/sustained-hits)**

combat.unresolved: An Or: bullet that changes what an effect gives is read as a numbered option with no effect.

detail.durationBasis: Core Rules 01.02.02: the card gives no duration, so the granted abilities last only for the phase in which the Stratagem is used.
